description: Anisotropic Gaussian Covariance. d=12->18 stalk extension with Sector D log-Cholesky. G_inject_D aligned to B_hat, modulated by tau_opt. Covariance tensor test: Sigma_mir = R*Sigma_fwd*R^T.

stalk_layout.Sector_D: [12:18] log_l11, log_l22, log_l33, l21, l31, l32  (log-Cholesky)

Sigma_construction: Sigma = L @ L.T where L lower-triangular with positive diagonal via exp(log_lii)

P_yz_covariance_proof.transformation: Sigma_mir = R * Sigma_fwd * R^T  where R = diag(-1,1,1)
P_yz_covariance_proof.NOT_invariant: Covariance is a tensor, not a scalar. Sigma_mir != Sigma_fwd.
P_yz_covariance_proof.G_D5_invariant: G_D[5] = ... * B_hat[1] * B_hat[2] unchanged => S_D[5] unchanged
P_yz_covariance_proof.l32_mir: l32_mir = l32_fwd   (y-z off-diagonal, no x term)

validity_predicate: is_valid_covariance_401: no NaN/Inf in stalk[12:18], min_eigval(Sigma) > 0
tau_opt_modulation: G_inject_D scales with tau_opt/W_max. tau_opt from EXP-316 ghost_history (range {1,2,3}). Retarded-time: tau_opt from prior ghost_history entry.

GR_backreaction_extension.S_D: tracks anisotropic covariance of the splat
GR_backreaction_extension.l21_l31: off-diagonal Cholesky: encode tilt of the Gaussian splat toward Zeeman field B_hat
GR_backreaction_extension.tau_opt_modulation: stronger lag (higher tau_opt) -> faster covariance alignment
GR_backreaction_extension.physical_analog: metric tensor perturbation delta_g_ij aligned to stress-energy flow

EXP_402_gate: Differentiable volume rendering: compute Gaussian splat integral over bbox using Sigma from Sector D. Requires valid is_valid_covariance_401 on all leaves.
